items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: making records with everybody, records on top of records, Jackie Gleason, Ethel Merman, Carol Channing, Carol Bruce.

ctx.x: So I got in Cafe Society with Ed Hall, stayed with Ed Hall for over three years. I was very good. And so they have another Cafe Society downtown, down in the Village, number 1, Sheridan Square, I think the number was. I stayed with Ed Hall for over three years, beautiful person to work for, just beautiful.

And I was living at 513 Edgecombe. That's there at 159 150th and 9th and Edgecombe with that little lady there. So I finally started to playing those Broadway musicals and making records with everybody, records on top of records, Jackie Gleason, Ethel Merman, Carol Channing, Carol Bruce.
